title: Add Packing List CTA on Travel Style Quiz results

requirements.summary: Add a prominent English-labeled shortcut on the Travel Style Quiz completed/results view that navigates via hash routing to the existing #packing-list route.
acceptanceCriteria: After completing the Travel Style Quiz and reaching the “Your Travel Style Revealed!” results view, a visible shortcut/CTA is rendered on that page.
Clicking/tapping the shortcut navigates using the app’s existing hash routing to #packing-list and renders the PackingList page.
The shortcut is not shown during the quiz questions flow (only on the completed/results view).
No new pages are created; the existing PackingList route in App.tsx is used.

file_operations.description: In the quizCompleted/results render branch (the screen that shows the “Your Travel Style Revealed!” heading), add a prominent CTA element with an English label (e.g., “Personalize your packing list here”) that sets the hash navigation to '#packing-list' using the app’s existing hash-based pattern (e.g., window.location.hash = '#packing-list'), ensuring it is only rendered on the completed/results view and not during the question flow.
